narrative_purpose: Show Pandora's unique twist: Eywa's living root-and-mycelial network — a super-legacy — is pyrolyzed to black inside the dead zone and cut clean at the ecotone, unable to reseed the burial from within.
subject: A horizontal cutaway across a boundary in the ground. On the LEFT, inside the dead zone: blackened, pyrolyzed root trunks in sterile grey ash, broken and disconnected, no glow. On the RIGHT, the living forest side: dark soil richly threaded with a glowing cyan mycelial-and-root network linking healthy roots. The glowing web reaches the boundary and stops abruptly, its severed ends dark where they meet the dead side.
scene: An underground cross-section spanning an ecotone: dead sterilised ground on one side, living networked soil on the other, the seam between them the focal point.
camera: Side-on cross-section, the boundary running vertically down the centre.
light: Living cyan network glow fills the right half; the left half is unlit, cool, blackened. The contrast in glow marks the severance.
palette: Left: black pyrolyzed roots in grey ash, no glow. Right: dark indigo soil with bright Pandora-cyan network filaments. Warm accent absent.
style: Painterly naturalist cutaway plate, the glowing network painterly not neon-UI.
detail_level: Crisp on the severed network ends at the boundary and the glowing web on the living side; dead side deliberately dim and broken.
composition: Vertical boundary at centre, dead disconnected roots left, glowing connected web right, severed ends meeting at the seam; generous deep indigo negative space.
consistency_notes: The glowing network is the biological fabric of Eywa; it must be clearly ALIVE and connected on the living side and DEAD and cut on the burial side, stopping at the seam. Cool Pandora palette, cyan life-glow only on the living half. Keep generous deep indigo negative space.
